Judge Halts Ontario's Cash Bail System Amid Legal Challenge

An Ontario judge has granted an injunction to halt the province's new cash bail system. Legal groups had argued that the system, introduced by Doug Ford's government, was unconstitutional. The injunction suspends the payment requirements of the bail system.
